mapper.sql: SELECT a.id AS application_id, a.student_id, a.status, j.id AS job_posting_id, j.company_name, j.title, CAST(d.document AS CHAR) AS document FROM application a JOIN job_posting j ON j.id = a.job_posting_id LEFT JOIN application_document d ON d.application_id = a.id WHERE a.id = #{applicationId}
mapper.update: UPDATE application_document SET document = #{document} WHERE application_id = #{applicationId}
UPDATE application SET status = 'SUBMITTED', submitted_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{applicationId} AND status = 'DRAFT'
UPDATE student SET last_response_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{studentId}
